# Code blocks and tables at a page foot

Every section below is a paragraph, a code block and a table. Across several printed pages
some page foot lands inside a code block or a table row. Each must move to the next page
whole: no empty grey sliver and no empty row at the foot, and no strip of grey or a
stray border line in the next page's top margin. A table header stays with its first row.

## Section 1

Paragraph 1: ordinary prose with **bold**, *italic*, `code` and a [link](https://example.com). ordinary prose with **bold**, *italic*, `code` and a [link](https://example.com). 

```
section 1 code line 1
section 1 code line 2
section 1 code line 3
section 1 code line 4
section 1 code line 5
section 1 code line 6
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | 1 | row 1 |

| 1.3 | 3 | row 3 |
